feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 September 2026 11:53am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 27 September 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Frontal system will move quickly through the Irish Sea early this afternoon, weak ridge of high pressure will then build.


##Wind##

South or Southeast 5 to 7 over much of the area at first, but West 6 or 7 in the west and becoming West 6 or 7 in all waters early this afternoon as the front moves eastwards. Decreasing West 5 or 6 late afternoon, then 4 or 5 this evening. Further decreasing West or Southwest 3 or 4 later tonight. Backing South or Southwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, possibly moderate to rough in a few places for a time, then gradually falling slight later today and overnight.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing eastwards this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, becoming good this afternoon.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, gradually backing Southeast through the rest of tomorrow, increasing 5 or 6 overnight into Tuesday, then 6 or 7 on Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
